G.S.R. 385(E).In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) tead with clause 0) of sub-
the following rules further to-amend the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 201 I, namely:
1. (1) These rules may be called as the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Amendment) Rules, 2015.
(2) Save as otherwise'provided in these rules, they shall come into force on the date of theiripublication in the:
Official Gazette.
2.
In the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 201l (hereinafer referred to -as the said
rules), in rule,2,-
(i) forclauses (bb) and (be), the following clauses shali be substituted, namely:-
'(bb)"industrial consumer"means the consumer who buys packaged commodities directly
from the manufacturer or from an importer or from wholesale dealer for use by that industry
and the package shall have declaration''not forretail sale'; .
(bc) "institutional consumer" means the institution who hires or avails of the facilities of
services in connection: with transport, hotel, hospital or other organisation which buy
packaged commodities directly from the manufacturer or from an imporfer or from wholesale
dealer for use by that institution, and the package shall have declaration 'not for retail sale's
(il) iniclause (k), the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:
"Provided that for the purposes of "retail food package", the definition of the isame contained
in the rulesor regulations made under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34/of 2006)
shall apply..

In the said rules, in rule 6,
() for sub-rute (2), the following sub-rule shall be substituted w,e.f Ist January, 2016, namely:-
"(2) Every paekage shall bear the name, address, telephone number, (e-mail iaddress of the
person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.?
(i) after sub-rule (8), the following sub-rule shal be inserted, namely.-
"(9) Without prejudice fo the provisions contained in this rule, if shall be perinissible to affix

4.

(i) in sub-rule (D), for the words "five cubic centimeters or less' the words 'ten cubic centimeters or
less shallbe substituted;
(im) after sub-rule (4), the following sub-rule shall be inserted wie.f. 1s' January, 2016) namely-
"(5) the area not including the'top, bottom, flange at top and bottom of cans, and shoulders and neck
of bottle and jars shall be determined as follows, nanely-
(a)  in the case of a rectangular package, where one entire side can properly be considered to
ibe the principal display panel side, the product of the height multiplied by the width of
that side..
(b) in case of a cylindrical or nearly cylindrical package, 40 per cent of the product of the
height of the package multiplied by the circumference.
(c) in case of any other.shaped package, 40 per cent of the total surface of the package, or an
area considered to be a principal display panel of the package.
In the said ruies, in rule 9, in sub-rule (3), the proviso shall be omitted.

Words 'ten cubic centimeters or less' shall be substituted.

Explanation.- For the purposes of this sub-rule, it is clarified that for indicating the unit for fitre, the

(i) after'sub-rule (5), the following sub-ruie shall beinserted, namelyt-
"(6) where there are inumber of packages of the same commodity in a prepackage, the mumber of
packages and the quantity of each package shall be indicated as a supplementary quantity declaration
in the package.
Explanation.- For the purposes of this sub-rule, where the net quantity of a package is one hundred
grams, the number of packages multiplied by the net quantity of each package shall be separately
indicated 'in numbers multiplied by its individual weight (i.e 10 number x 10 gram).
